label: Store an entry and its method's latest
description: Data graph behind monitor.record: the entry is stored and the latest call of its method is recorded beside it, and the graph answers only when both are in. The two writes move together -- a reader asking which call was the latest POST can never be told an entry that was not stored, and no entry can be stored without its method's latest catching up. That is what atomic buys here, and it is one word rather than a graph that undoes what it wrote. The same graph as @monitor/data/store-and-latest.graph.json, against the store kept in PostgreSQL: a store is named statically at a call site, so pointing these at another connection is a copy until a profile may swap one.
